latestVersion.changelog:
Film Location Scout 1.0.0 – Initial Release

- Discover 5 nearby film and TV shooting locations tailored to your city and position.
- Each location case includes: a cinematic scene image (with 1–2 prominent foreground characters), GPS coordinates, detailed scene description, and weather-adapted photography parameters.
- Designed for easy photo recreation at iconic spots, with composition and phone shooting tips.
- Supports natural queries about movie/TV locations, scene photography, and cinematic spot guides.
- Automatically fetches local weather, light, and precise locations; outputs results in structured, user-friendly cards.
